title: Circuit breaker recovery protocol
body: A task in 'blocked' status (circuit breaker fired) cannot be picked up by any agent. Recovery requires: (1) @miguel manually sets status back to 'todo' or 'waiting_human'. (2) Root cause of repeated failure must be identified before re-queuing. (3) If root cause is agent capacity (quota, sandbox), reassign to a different agent or request human implementation. Automatic re-dispatch without root cause analysis will repeat the death spiral.
